definitions.explanation: The position lower than something else or the lower surface of something.
Can indicate someone younger or lower in status.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}は{椅子|いす}の{下|した}にいます。
examples.english: The cat is under the chair.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}は{机|つくえ}の{下|した}にあります。
examples.english: The book is under the desk.

examples.japanese: {橋|はし}の{下|した}に{川|かわ}があります。
examples.english: There is a river under the bridge.

examples.japanese: {傘|かさ}がないので、{木|き}の{下|した}で{雨|あめ}がやむのを{待|ま}ちました。
examples.english: I didn't have an umbrella, so I waited under a tree for the rain to stop.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{二|ふた}つ{下|した}です。
examples.english: My younger brother is two years younger.

examples.japanese: {妹|いもうと}は{私|わたし}より{三|さん}つ{下|した}です。
examples.english: My younger sister is three years younger than me.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{私|わたし}より{一|ひと}つ{下|した}です。
examples.english: She is one year younger than me.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}では{自分|じぶん}より{下|した}の{人|ひと}に{仕事|しごと}を{教|おし}えます。
examples.english: At work, you teach the job to people below you.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}の{下|した}には{新|あたら}しく{入|はい}った{人|ひと}が{三人|さんにん}います。
examples.english: There are three people below me who joined recently.

notes:
{下|した} indicates a position below something, or can refer to being younger or lower in rank/status.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜の{下|した}に: under ~, below ~
- 〜の{下|した}で: under (authority/supervision of)
- {年下|としした}: younger person

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {地下|ちか}: underground, basement
- {下着|したぎ}: underwear
- {下|した}{手|て}: unskillful, poor at
- {目下|めした}: subordinate, junior

CONTRAST:
- {下|した}: below, under (opposite: {上|うえ})
- {下|しも}: downstream, lower part (in compounds)

USAGE FOR AGE:
〜つ{下|した} indicates how many years younger: {三|さん}つ{下|した} = three years younger.
